messages.subject: FW: clarification on function annotate.WithGenicParts
parts:
Hi,

 

I am using the function ”annotate.WithGenicParts”

 

I would like to understand the TRUE and FALSE  option for strand.

I just want to ensure that when I set the options for strand to “TRUE” that CG strand is being annotated to Transcripts ONLY from the same strand, ie if the CG is on the “-“ strand, that the transcript is also from the “-“ strand only.

 

Michelle

 

From: Michelle Johnson
Sent: 29 August 2014 11:38
To: 'methylkit_...@googlegroups.com'
Subject: clarification on function annotate.WithGenicParts

 

Hi,

 

I just want clarification on the TRUE and FALSE.

 

I set my values to TRUE, thinking that the annotations will only match “-“ strand CGs to “-“ strand transcripts.  Or do I have this the wrong way around? 

I read the documentation which says “If set to TRUE, annotation features and target features will be overlapped based on strand (def:FALSE)”

 

Thanks,

 

Michelle

messages.author: e4181d5c40fc094c
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] FW: clarification on function annotate.WithGenicParts
parts:
Hi,

To my understanding, CG methylation is symmetric ie., a C (in CG context) methylated will have methylation on the opposite strand too! Atleast in my data in a number of cases the methylation percentage is also similar. So, strand=T or strand=F may mean same (for non CG context my explanation is not applicable).

And yes, your have understood it right!


Regards,
Kalyan
